notes:
## New plugins and Item Spawn update

- Added Item Spawn with a fast in-game menu, full item catalog, multi-select and persistent item management.
- Added Steam and Epic support for Item Spawn and the rebuilt Title Swapper.
- Added Game Sounds for goals, saves, crossbars and demolitions, including previews and reliable event detection.
- Added improved Workshop Map browsing with Most Downloaded, Newest, Top Rated and Downloaded filters.
- Added downloadable catalogs and ZIP importing for Custom Decals, Boost Meters and Balls.
- Added Workshop Rooms with hosting, joining and an in-app tutorial.
- Improved overlay reliability and fixed the blank blue development window.
